# dsh-drawio

**Let the agent draw real draw.io diagrams.** Install this and DeepSeek can write `.drawio` files
(f

lowcharts, org charts, ER boxes) straight into your workspace, and you can open them in an actual
dr
aw.io editor inside the Harness sidebar — no copy-paste, no external upload.

DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x** and **Node.js >= 22.6**. Web profile only (the panel is a
browser surface).
After installing, restart DSH once so the client bundle loads. You get:

- a **图表 / Diagrams** icon in the sidebar,
- the **`drawio`** tool for the agent,
- a panel that ope
ns every `.drawio` file in your workspace.
## What it changes for you
Ask the agent for a flowchart and it writes a file instead of ASCII art:
> 画一个登录流程图，密码错误就提示重试

The agent calls `drawio` with `action: "create"`, nodes, and edges. The result is
`docs/登录流程.drawio`
— a real draw.io document you can open, drag boxes in, and save back.
The panel previews any diagram as SVG, and switches to draw.io's own editor on demand.
## The `drawio` tool
| action | what it does |

| `create` | build a new diagram from `nodes` + `edges` (layout is computed) |
| `edit` | add / upda

te / remove cells in an existing file |
| `read` | return its nodes and edges as structured data |
|

`export` | write a standalone SVG beside the diagram |
| `delete` | remove the file |
| `list` | fi
nd diagrams in the workspace |
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Shapes: `rect` `rounded` `ellipse` `circle` `diamond` `parallelogram` `hexagon` `cylinder`
`document
` `cloud` `note` `actor` `database` `text`. Palettes: `default` `mono` `warm`.
## Permissions and external services
Be aware of exactly what this plugin touches:
- **Filesystem.** Reads and writes `.drawio` files **only inside registered workspaces**. Every path

goes through one policy module; anything outside a workspace, or anything that is not `.drawio`,
is

refused with a reason rather than silently clamped.
- **HTTP routes.** Five endpoints under `/api/d

sh-drawio` (`config`, `list`, `document`,
`save`, `preview`). They accept **loopback sockets only**,

and mutations additionally require a
same-origin `Origin` / `Sec-Fetch-Site` signal, so a page on a

nother site cannot drive your editor.
- **One external origin.** The embedded editor loads `https://

embed.diagrams.net` in an iframe.
That is draw.io's official embed build. In embed mode it has **no

storage**: the document travels
between your browser and this Host over `postMessage`, and is never

sent to draw.io's servers.
If the origin is unreachable, the panel falls back to the local SVG previ

ew instead of breaking.
- **No telemetry, no analytics, no network calls** from the Host half.
- **N

o third-party npm dependencies.** The package is plain JavaScript, and it deliberately imports
no `@
deepseek-ai/*` package (see *Notes* below).
## Compatibility and known limits
- **DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`** (declared in the manifest `engines.dsh`; built and te

sted on 0.2.1-rc.5)
- **Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`** (declared in the manifest `engines.node`)
-

Web profile only; the client half targets the Harness Web UI.
- Only the **first page** of a multi-

page `<mxfile>` is edited. Other pages are preserved byte-for-byte
but not operated on.
- The SVG pr

eview covers the 14 named shapes above. A diagram using exotic draw.io stencils still
previews as bo

xes and edges; the embedded editor remains the exact view.
- Export produces **SVG only** — no raste

rizer is bundled, so no PNG/PDF.
- The model's edits never re-render the page, so geometry you set b
y hand in the editor survives.
## Why it is written this way
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The model never writes XML; the editor never touches the filesystem. Both share one path policy and
one document normalizer, which is why an agent-written diagram opens in the editor and a human's dra

g
survives the agent's next edit.
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]
No build step, no dependencies. `test/` is excluded from the published tarball.
